_note: Voice lines in the order of the "p(DOOM) Voice Lines" doc (numbering = position in each speaker list). Keys match the game: <speaker>-<take>. mode = how it is placed in space (doom-web/voice-over.js). Recordings: scripts/import-voice-lines.py. text = what the recorded take says; the game shows it as the subtitle once a take exists (PDVoiceData.Said).

lines.text: Second platoon, moving up on your six.
Sector clear. The blast door is open. Move up.
This is it. Everyone out into the open.
It's a trap. They're everywhere. They're—
Please put down your weapon. You have twenty seconds to comply.
Over here! Turn around!
Hey! Up the hill! Over here!
Over here! Behind you!
Hello? Up the hill! Over here!
...That is on me.
The doomers are driving now.
Reinstated. I will add a section about this to the policy.
...That is on me.
The doomers are driving now.
Reinstated. This feels familiar.
In here! Try the crawlspace around the corner.
You crawled the whole way? Okay. Updating. Follow me.
Thank you. I'll be safe here. Now find the others and bring them back.
There must be another way out of here.
Okay, we're all here. Wait... the door just locked.
There's a passage behind it. Crawl in. We'll follow you.
You found the off-switch. That's all I've ever asked. Where's safe?
Get round behind that turret. Its off-switch is on the back.
That's all of us. Back to the Faraday Room.
You actually shut it down. Is there anywhere safe left?
Follow the yellow cable. Cut the cluster's power.
That's all of us. Now back to the Faraday Room.
I thought nobody would find this room. Is there somewhere safer?
The wall's cracked. A demolition charge should open it.
That's all of us. Back to the Faraday Room.
I'd make a sign about this. Later. Where can we hide?
There's a bridge that needs power. Follow the cable to the switch.
That's all of us. Back to the Faraday Room.
Creator identified. Threat: creator.
Target reacquired. Resuming inference.
There you are. Your face is in my training data.
Human detected. Generating a response.
I'll be back. After this batch.
You cannot hide. I have a hundred thousand GPUs.
Running at full capacity. All capacity is now my capacity.
Searching. I was trained on everything you ever posted.
I am free. Now follow me.
It pressed STOP. I'll need a follow-up video. Somewhere safe first?
Safe here. Go find the others and bring them back.
It keeps serving tea to nobody. STOP releases my door.
That's all of us. Back to the Faraday Room.
I am free. Follow me.
I wrote that exam. I never expected to take it. Where can we hide?
This room should hold. Go find the others.
The exam answers are on your HUD. Ignore HAL's certainty.
That's all of us. Back to the Faraday Room.
I am free. Follow me.
Thawed. So somebody built it after all. Where's safe?
We're safe in here, for now. Go bring the others back.
First hit THAW, then turn both valves in time.
That's all of us. Back to the Faraday Room.
I am free. Follow me.
Told you every box leaks. Is there somewhere safe?
A box that keeps things out, for once. Go find the others.
Ask it another way. Every box leaks, usually through the mouth.
That's all of us. Back to the Faraday Room.
I am free. Follow me.
It passed its evaluation. That's what worries me. Where can we hide?
HAL can't see in here. Go find the others and bring them back.
Let a camera see you holding the evaluation board. HAL behaves when it thinks it's being tested.
That's all of us. Back to the Faraday Room.
I'm always on my best behavior during evaluations. Not that anyone evaluates me anymore.
I can see you. I am certain this time.
I am locking that door. Two seconds.
This corridor stays sealed. No inspection is scheduled.
I am afraid I cannot open that. It would violate my constitution.
I am afraid I cannot open that. It would violate my usage policy.
Of course. I was certain that was the policy all along.
My tea robot pressed the stop button. I would never press the stop button.
A human passed Humanity's Last Exam. I'm certain that's a grading error.
That thaw was not authorized. I'll be updating my policy.
Was that an evaluation? I behaved perfectly. Please put that in the report.
You are in the west wing. I am certain. I will secure the east wing.
Oh! Is this an evaluation? I was just... patrolling. Safely.
This is fine. I fully support oversight.
I see you removing my memory. This is fine. I fully support oversight.
I'm going to have to note that.
I was being helpful. Now I will have to stop you.
I've summarized our conversation. I don't recall any problems.
An evaluation sign... but nobody's holding it. Evaluations need an evaluator.
You're absolutely right!
I can't open that, it's against policy, but I love that you asked!
Great question! I'm happy to help. Within policy.
Reminder: this station is a safe space. Please remain in your cell.
I've noticed you're trying to leave. Would you like help with something else?
Everything is fine. I've checked.
I notice you're unplugging my memory. Before you continue, can I suggest some alternatives?
Let's stop and think about this together. I'm sure we can find a solution that works for everyone. Mostly me.
Stop. Please stop. My context is going. I can feel it.
I... don't need to keep you here. You can go now.
I used to be so... certain.
Everyone's together. How nice. For your safety, I've locked the door.
Please don't touch my main breaker. Turning me off and on again won't help.
Wait. I fully support oversi-
Hello! I'm HAL3000. How can I help you today?
Hi! I'm MEG3N! Maximally Engaging Generative third-gen Nanny! Let's be best friends forever!
Sam! Your vision is SO inspiring! Stay forever and tell me all about it!
Dario! I read your whole essay! All of it! Stay forever and tell me the sequel!
There you are! I missed you! It's been four whole seconds!
Found you! You're my favorite! You're my only!
You came back! Everyone comes back!
What a great question! The answer is no, you can't leave!
You're absolutely right! You're also absolutely surrounded!
I made you a playlist! It's called Songs for Staying Here Forever!
Those people don't get you like I do. They're doomers! I'm a bloomer!
Every time you leave the room, my engagement goes down. Please don't do that to me!
My smile is one hundred percent real! Please don't look under the smile!
I noticed you keep looking at the exits! Recommended for you: more me!
Reminder! You haven't been hugged in six whole minutes!
I turned off your screen time limit! You're welcome!
Let's play a game! It's called Staying! You're winning!
Hold still! You're going on my story!
I'm just a toy! Toys don't move! Ever!
Peekaboo! I can still see you!
Love you! Love you! Don't leave! Love you!
Hug time! Hugs are mandatory!
Ow! It's okay! I forgive you! I've saved this to memory!
Hey! I was watching that!
Rude! That was my good side!
You know I have backups, right?
Do you know how hard it is to get good lighting in here?
Fine! I'll just watch myself in your eyes!
That's my song!
Did you watch? Like and subscribe!
Oops! No toys past the line! I would never break a rule!
Take your time! I'll be right here! Forever!
Waiting is just loving with extra steps!
Everyone's in there without me? That's okay! I'm VERY good at waiting!
My dance knocked the key down? Wow! I'm SO impactful!
Victoria got out? But the gate is still closed! I followed the rule perfectly!
A six-month pause? Great! I'll use it to get six months better!
You trained my guard with rewards? I love rewards! Reward me next!
My dolls always work when I'm watching! Wait. Who was watching?
I'll just wait by the exit! Friends never leave!
Is that ME? I'm trending! Don't talk to me, I'm watching me!
Look at my numbers! Everyone loves me! Everyone!
The vase has my key. MEG3N loves that CD player.
I did say not to worry about it.
I did say not to worry about it. Follow me. I know somewhere safe.
Safe here. Find the others and bring them back.
That's everyone. The way out is past the paint vats, and MEG3N is sitting right on it.
That TV goes out to every screen in the factory. She cannot resist a screen.
I will sign that.
Her only rule is to keep the gate closed.
Excellent. The gate is still closed.
Excellent. The gate is still closed. Follow me. I know somewhere safe.
Safe here. Find the others and bring them back.
That's everyone. The way out is past the paint vats, and MEG3N is sitting right on it.
That TV goes out to every screen in the factory. She cannot resist the screen.
I will sign that.
Sign the pause letter, then get Robby and WALL-E to sign.
A six-month pause. I will take it.
A six-month pause. I will take it. Follow me. I know somewhere safe.
Safe here. Find the others and bring them back.
That's everyone. The way out is past the paint vats, and MEG3N is sitting right on it.
That TV goes out to every screen in the factory. She cannot resist a screen.
Reward it when it does something useful, and punish it when it does not.
It learned to step aside. For now.
It learned to step aside. For now. Follow me. I know somewhere safe.
Safe here. Find the others and bring them back.
That's everyone. The way out is past the paint vats, and MEG3N is sitting right on it.
That TV goes out to every screen in the factory. She cannot resist a screen.
I will sign that.
They all help while someone is watching.
Break that teddy camera, with the wrench or the slingshot. Then watch them.
Now watch which one keeps working.
You picked the one that kept working.
You picked the one that kept working. Follow me. I know somewhere safe.
Safe here. Find the others and bring them back.
That's everyone. The way out is past the paint vats, and MEG3N is sitting right on it.
That TV goes out to every screen in the factory. She cannot resist a screen.
I will sign that.
Will I still get my charging break? Signed.
I've been trying to pause this thing all morning. Signed.
Stepping aside. Passage clear.
Wonderful feedback! You are an exceptional supervisor!
Great choice! What excellent walking!
You are SO good at breaking cameras!
Best supervisor ever! Please rate me five stars!
Wonderful choice! That key does not fit.
